title: Fix logout to fully clear authenticated UI state and prevent stale cached data

requirements.summary: Ensure logout fully clears identity-bound React Query state and the UI cannot show stale profile/admin/reports across account switches, using the existing full-cleanup logout flow without modifying immutable auth hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Triggering logout results in the app returning to an unauthenticated state (no identity-bound data visible) after the logout flow completes.
After logging out from User A and logging in as User B, User A’s cached data (profile and reports) is not shown at any point.
Logout does not depend on editing immutable auth hook files (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts); fixes are implemented via other frontend components/hooks that are allowed to change.

file_operations.description: Harden identity-scoped queries/mutations against stale data by (1) disabling identity-bound queries when unauthenticated and (2) scoping relevant query keys by the current principal string so cached data cannot bleed between users. This aligns with the authorization component guidance to clear cached application data on logout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an explicit auth control in the header: when authenticated, provide a Logout action that calls the existing useFullLogout().performLogout() full-cleanup flow; when unauthenticated, provide a Login action that triggers useInternetIdentity().login(). Use existing shadcn-ui primitives (e.g., Button / DropdownMenu) for consistent UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an authentication gate component that prevents rendering identity-bound pages when there is no identity, ensuring the UI never displays cached profile/admin/reports after logout. When unauthenticated, show a minimal login prompt (button wired to useInternetIdentity().login()); when authenticated, render children. Optionally integrate existing signup/profile completion components if already used by the app flow. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire AuthGate into the app's root layout so all main routes are blocked behind authentication (or otherwise ensure routes that show identity-bound data cannot render when logged out). This wiring must ensure logout reliably returns the UI to an unauthenticated view without showing previously cached data. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
